meta.title: Trust in parliament
meta.question: How much do Poles trust the Sejm and parliament?
meta.measure: Average trust in parliament, from 0 (no trust at all) to 10 (complete trust)
meta.anchor: Pooled from every question on trust or confidence in the Sejm and parliament, with every answer placed on 0 to 10 and the trend read on the scale of an average question.

items.wording: How much confidence do you have in parliament?
items.notes: EVS, 1990, 1999, 2008, 2017 (4 surveys). 'A great deal / quite a lot / not very much / none at all'.

items.wording: Trust in parliament
items.notes: CDCEE, January 1991 and March 2000. 'Totally / to a certain point / little / not at all'.

items.wording: Confidence in the Sejm (full / moderate / none)
items.notes: PGSS 1992, 1993, 1994, 1995, 1997, 1999 (6 surveys); 'pełne / umiarkowane / nie mam zaufania'. Version x of the battery: asked of everyone 1992-95, of a random half (split ballot with version y) in 1997 and 1999.

items.wording: How much confidence do you have in parliament?
items.notes: WVS Poland, 1989, 1997, 2005, 2012 (4 surveys). 'A great deal / quite a lot / not very much / none at all'. The 1989 wave predates the trend's 1990 start.

items.wording: Does the Sejm deserve trust? (definitely deserves ... definitely does not)
items.notes: PGSS 1997, 1999, 2002, 2005, 2008, 2010 (6 surveys); 'zdecydowanie zasługuje na zaufanie ... zdecydowanie nie zasługuje', midpoint 'ani ... ani'. Version y of the battery: random half of the sample in 1997, 1999 and 2002, everyone from 2005.

items.wording: To what degree do you trust the Sejm? (1 complete trust ... 5 complete lack of trust)
items.notes: CBOS, 2000-11 (APiW 126), 1 survey. 'Do jakiego stopnia darzy Pan(i) zaufaniem', 1 = complete trust ... 5 = complete lack of trust.

items.wording: Do you tend to trust or not to trust the (national) parliament?
items.notes: Candidate Countries Eurobarometer 2001.1, 2002.2, 2003.2, 2003.4, 2004.1 (5 surveys). 'Tend to trust / tend not to trust'.

items.wording: Do you, generally speaking, trust the Sejm and Senate? (definitely ... definitely not)
items.notes: CBOS, 2002-01, 2004-01, 2006-01, 2008-01, 2010-01, 2012-01, 2014-03, 2016-01 (8 surveys). CBOS biennial trust battery ('Czy, ogólnie rzecz biorąc, ma Pan(i) zaufanie, czy też nie ma Pan(i) zaufania, do ...'), four answers plus 'trudno powiedzieć'. Labels vary: '... - X' (2002, 2004, 2010-16), 'zaufanie do K) X' (2006-01), 'zaufanie do X' (2008-01). In 2014 the battery was split across APiW 284 (January) and 286 (March).

items.wording: To what degree does parliament inspire your trust? (1 no trust ... 7 great trust)
items.notes: CBOS, 2002-09 (APiW 148), 1 survey. 1 = no trust ... 7 = great trust.

items.wording: Trust in the country's parliament (0 no trust at all ... 10 complete trust)
items.notes: ESS Poland, rounds 1-11 (2002-2023), 11 surveys. Round 10 (2021-22) was self-completion; the pipeline's MODE_SPLITS makes it a question of its own.

items.wording: Trust in the (national) parliament, 1 no trust at all ... 10 complete trust
items.notes: European Election Study 2004 (ZA4566, June 2004), 1 survey. Code 0 flags Spain and Sweden's 0-10 version and is outside the scale.

items.wording: Do you tend to trust or not to trust the (national) parliament?
items.notes: Standard/EP Eurobarometer, 2004-2026, 46 surveys. 'Tend to trust / tend not to trust', DK outside the scale. Label 'NAT PARLIAMENT' to EB 78.1 (2012), 'NATIONAL PARLIAMENT' from EB 76.3 (2011).

items.wording: Do you have trust in parliament / the Sejm? (definitely yes ... definitely no)
items.notes: CBOS, 2004-10, 2004-11, 2006-12 (3 surveys). One-off CBOS trust questions answered 'zdecydowanie tak ... zdecydowanie nie' (not the 'mam zaufanie' battery).

items.wording: Trust in the Sejm and Senate on an 11-point scale (1 complete lack of trust ... 11 full trust)
items.notes: CBOS, 2008-07 (APiW 218), 1 survey. 11-point card, 1 = complete lack of trust ... 11 = full trust (intermediate codes unlabelled).

items.wording: How much trust do you have in parliament (Sejm and Senate)? (very much / average / not much / none)
items.notes: CBOS, 2009-04 (APiW 227), 1 survey. 'Bardzo dużym / średnim / niezbyt dużym / żadnym': the scale is not symmetric (no 'large' step), placed linearly.

items.wording: Trust in parliament on a 1-10 scale (1 do not trust at all ... 10 trust completely)
items.notes: Eurobarometer 72.1 (ZA4975, August-September 2009), 1 survey. Do not also use its recode (REC).

items.wording: To what extent do you trust the Sejm (lower chamber)? (very high ... very low)
items.notes: POLPAN 2013 (E05) and 2018 (E02), 2 waves; 1 = very high ... 5 = very low (or no) trust. The 2013 duplicate in the P3 supplement (UZP3*, reversed scale, about 500 respondents) is deliberately not matched. POLPAN is a panel with refreshment samples.

items.wording: You trust the (national) parliament: yes totally / yes somewhat / no not really / no not at all
items.notes: EES 2014 (ZA5160, Eurobarometer post-election survey), 1 survey.

items.wording: You trust the (national) parliament: yes totally ... neither ... no not at all
items.notes: EES 2019 voter study (ZA7581), 1 survey; fielded online, with a 'neither trust nor distrust' midpoint.

items.wording: Trust in the country's parliament (0 no trust at all ... 10 complete trust)
items.notes: ESS round 10 (2021-22): self-completion by web and paper in Poland, where every other round was face to face, so a question of its own.

items.wording: Trust in parliament (Sejm and Senate)
items.notes: PGSW 2023. 'Trust very much / rather trust / rather distrust / completely distrust'.
